open_points.subject: _camera_offset
open_points.text: _camera_offset: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return the fixed time zone of the offset only when it is in the form the EXIF standard gives its OffsetTime tags and nothing else, whose hours are not above the imported CAMERA_OFFSET_MAX_HOURS constant and whose minutes are a clock minute, and MUST return None for any other value.
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The OffsetTime form must be supplied through one of the three permitted value paths, such as an imported provider constant naming the format or validation pattern, instead of requiring the generator to recover it from the external EXIF standard.

open_points.subject: _parse_exif_moment
open_points.text: _parse_exif_moment: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None unless text, once its trailing NUL characters and spaces are removed, is exactly a valid calendar date and time in the form the EXIF standard gives its DateTime tags; that local time MUST be read at the offset _camera_offset gives for offset, or, when it gives None, in zone taking the first occurrence of a time that occurs twice and the offset in force before the change for a time that does not exist, and turned into UTC by _to_naive_utc; it MUST return None when the UTC year is before the imported CAMERA_EARLIEST_YEAR constant or the moment lies more than the imported CAMERA_LATEST_AFTER_MODIFIED_HOURS constant of hours after modified, and the moment otherwise.
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The DateTime form must be supplied through one of the three permitted value paths, such as an imported provider constant naming the format or validation pattern, instead of requiring the generator to recover it from the external EXIF standard.
